prompter.text: Somebody I've never met liked this.
Show Crypto. Now the Nerdster shows its work.
Their name is a link into the network.
Here they are. My vouch reaches them in a few hops.
Raw, it is just a public key -- the thing itself.

The Nerdster interprets keys it knows,
so they read as names.

And this is the delegate key their
Nerdster statements are signed with.
The shield holds the delegation itself.

Signed by their identity key --
the one Tom vouched for.

They delegated this key to nerdster.org from their
identity app. The chain is unbroken.
